## Introduction
Medical imaging datasets are useful for many kinds of research and development. This dataset was collected as part of a study and includes MRI scans from patients. The goal of collecting the data was to support research and allow others to explore the images. Researchers may find the dataset helpful for testing methods, studying imaging data, or learning more about medical imaging.

## Methods
### Subject Inclusion and Exclusion Criteria
Patients were included in the dataset if they participated in the study and had MRI scans available. Some patients were excluded if their data was incomplete or could not be used. The dataset includes participants from a medical study and contains imaging data collected during that study. Other details about the subjects may be provided in the dataset files.
